tvSeasonFromTMDB.name: Season 3
tvSeasonFromTMDB.overview: In season three, Carmen 'Carmy' Berzatto, Sydney Adamu, and Richard 'Richie' Jerimovich do what it takes to elevate The Bear, their beef stand turned fine dining establishment, to the highest level, all while doing their best just to stay in business. Our chefs have learned that every second counts, but this season we'll find out if they have what it takes to make it to tomorrow.
